question: Point out the INCORRECT response to type I hereditary angioneurotic edema.

options.opa: It is inherited following a pattern of autosomal recessive inheritance.
options.opb: It is due to a quantitative deficiency of the C1-inhibitor protein.
options.opc: It is characterized by repetitive and self-limited outbreaks of angioedema, which can put the patient's life at risk.
options.opd: It is the most frequent hereditary deficit of complement.
